name: Parasitology
description: Filipino examinees review parasitology as a dedicated subject covering protozoa, helminths, and blood and tissue parasites; the material maps to the Microbiology content domain of the ASCP BOC MLS content outline while remaining its own subject in Philippine ASCPi review programs.
blueprintNote: Mapped to the ASCP BOC MLS content outline (topic level) and to the subject structure used by Philippine ASCPi review centers (approximate weights, not official percentages; not affiliated with ASCP or any review center).
